text.description: Situated in the landmark Quay Point development on Bristol's vibrant Floating Harbour, this bright two bedroom apartment enjoys exceptional water views from a private decked balcony. Accommodation comprises an entrance hall with utility storage cupboard, an open-plan kitchen and living room with floor-to-ceiling glazing, master bedroom with en-suite shower room, a second double bedroom, and a stylish family bathroom. Includes one allocated underground parking space behind electronic security gates. The property has 112 years remaining on the lease. Annual service charge is £3,200 with ground rent of £350 per annum. Communal grounds only (no private garden).
